title: WPT rating (one line of a file in the rating format: a person's pass or fail on one attempt of a wpt-eval run; docs/evaluation.md)

task.description: the id of the task the attempt was made on: <source id>/<task folder>, as attempts.jsonl names it

weights.description: the sha256 of each weight file of the model that made the attempt, as the run record's ids.json names them (inputs.weights)

record.description: the wpt-eval run record folder whose attempts.jsonl holds the attempt (records/<folder>/ in the store)

attempt.description: the attempt's index, as attempts.jsonl holds it

plain.description: whether the attempt was offered every tool under its real name, as attempts.jsonl holds it: with the index, it tells apart the attempts of one task in one record

verdict.description: the person's verdict: is this what a co-worker would have delivered
